an8.80:0.3: The Grounds for Laziness & the Arousal of Energy
an8.80:1.1: “Monks, there are these eight grounds for laziness.
an8.80:1.3: “There is the case where a monk has some work to do.
an8.80:1.5: ‘I will have to do this work. But when I have done this work, my body will be tired. Why don’t I lie down?’ So he lies down.
an8.80:1.6: He doesn’t make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:1.7: This is the first ground for laziness.
an8.80:2.1: “Then there is the case where a monk has done some work.
an8.80:2.3: ‘I have done some work. Now that I have done work, my body is tired. Why don’t I lie down?’ So he lies down.
an8.80:2.4: He doesn’t make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:2.5: This is the second ground for laziness.
an8.80:3.1: “Then there is the case where a monk has to go on a journey.
an8.80:3.3: ‘I will have to go on this journey. But when I have gone on the journey, my body will be tired. Why don’t I lie down?’ So he lies down.
an8.80:3.4: He doesn’t make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:3.5: This is the third ground for laziness.
an8.80:4.1: “Then there is the case where a monk has gone on a journey.
an8.80:4.3: ‘I have gone on a journey. Now that I have gone on a journey, my body is tired. Why don’t I lie down?’ So he lies down.
an8.80:4.4: He doesn’t make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:4.5: This is the fourth ground for laziness.
an8.80:5.1: “Then there is the case where a monk, having gone for alms in a village or town, does not get as much coarse or refined food as he would like for his fill.
an8.80:5.3: ‘I, having gone for alms in a village or town, have not gotten as much coarse or refined food as I would like for my fill. This body of mine is tired & unsuitable for work. Why don’t I lie down?’ So he lies down.
an8.80:5.4: He doesn’t make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:5.5: This is the fifth ground for laziness.
an8.80:6.1: “Then there is the case where a monk, having gone for alms in a village or town, gets as much coarse or refined food as he would like for his fill.
an8.80:6.3: ‘I, having gone for alms in a village or town, have gotten as much coarse or refined food as I would like for my fill. This body of mine is heavy & unsuitable for work—stuffed with beans, as it were. Why don’t I lie down?’ So he lies down.
an8.80:6.4: He doesn’t make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:6.5: This is the sixth ground for laziness.
an8.80:7.1: “Then there is the case where a monk comes down with a slight illness.
an8.80:7.3: ‘I have come down with a slight illness. There’s a need to lie down.’ So he lies down.
an8.80:7.4: He doesn’t make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:7.5: This is the seventh ground for laziness.
an8.80:8.1: “Then there is the case where a monk has recovered from his illness, not long after his recovery.
an8.80:8.3: ‘I have recovered from my illness. It’s not long after my recovery. This body of mine is weak & unsuitable for work. Why don’t I lie down?’ So he lies down.
an8.80:8.4: He doesn’t make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:8.5: This is the eighth ground for laziness.
an8.80:8.6: “These are the eight grounds for laziness.
an8.80:9.1: “There are these eight grounds for the arousal of energy.
an8.80:9.3: “There is the case where a monk has some work to do.
an8.80:9.5: ‘I will have to do this work. But when I am doing this work, it will not be easy to attend to the Buddha’s message. Why don’t I make an effort beforehand for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized?’
an8.80:9.6: So he makes an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:9.7: This is the first ground for the arousal of energy.
an8.80:10.1: “Then there is the case where a monk has done some work.
an8.80:10.3: ‘I have done some work. While I was doing work, I couldn’t attend to the Buddha’s message. Why don’t I make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized?’
an8.80:10.4: So he makes an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:10.5: This is the second ground for the arousal of energy.
an8.80:11.1: “Then there is the case where a monk has to go on a journey.
an8.80:11.3: ‘I will have to go on this journey. But when I am going on the journey, it will not be easy to attend to the Buddha’s message. Why don’t I make an effort beforehand for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized?’ So he makes an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:11.4: This is the third ground for the arousal of energy.
an8.80:12.1: “Then there is the case where a monk has gone on a journey.
an8.80:12.3: ‘I have gone on a journey. While I was going on the journey, I couldn’t attend to the Buddha’s message. Why don’t I make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized?’ So he makes an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:12.4: This is the fourth ground for the arousal of energy.
an8.80:13.1: “Then there is the case where a monk, having gone for alms in a village or town, does not get as much coarse or refined food as he would like for his fill.
an8.80:13.3: ‘I, having gone for alms in a village or town, have not gotten as much coarse or refined food as I would like for my fill. This body of mine is light & suitable for work. Why don’t I make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized?’ So he makes an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:13.4: This is the fifth ground for the arousal of energy.
an8.80:14.1: “Then there is the case where a monk, having gone for alms in a village or town, gets as much coarse or refined food as he would like for his fill.
an8.80:14.3: ‘I, having gone for alms in a village or town, have gotten as much coarse or refined food as I would like for my fill. This body of mine is light1 & suitable for work. Why don’t I make an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized?’ So he makes an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:14.4: This is the sixth ground for the arousal of energy.
an8.80:15.1: “Then there is the case where a monk comes down with a slight illness.
an8.80:15.3: ‘I have come down with a slight illness. Now, there’s the possibility that it could get worse. Why don’t I make an effort beforehand for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized?’ So he makes an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:15.4: This is the seventh ground for the arousal of energy.
an8.80:16.1: “Then there is the case where a monk has recovered from his illness, not long after his recovery.
an8.80:16.3: ‘I have recovered from my illness. It’s not long after my recovery. Now, there’s the possibility that the illness could come back. Why don’t I make an effort beforehand for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized?’
an8.80:16.4: So he makes an effort for the attaining of the as-yet-unattained, the reaching of the as-yet-unreached, the realization of the as-yet-unrealized.
an8.80:16.5: This is the eighth ground for the arousal of energy.
an8.80:17.1: “These are the eight grounds for the arousal of energy.”
